title: The Three-Variable Conflict-Clause Poset: Graded Structure, Model Counting by Unobstructed Atoms, and Step-Counter Bounds, Formalized in Lean 4

creators.name: Frohman, Benjamin Stanley
creators.affiliation: Abstract AI Research Syndicate & Formal Methods Engineering Group

description: Lean 4 + Mathlib (v4.30.0-rc1) formalization of the poset of the 27 clauses over three variables under literal inclusion: layers 1/6/12/8, 54 covering edges, partial order with least element and greatest-lower-bound meet, alternating layer sum -1, cochain identities d o d = 0, and the exact identity #models(Phi) = #rank-3 clauses not implied by any clause of Phi. Also exact tick counts and upper bounds for two explicitly defined step-counting StateM programs, including (n+m)^2 + 2^(n/(log n)^(1/2+eps)) at block size ceil((log n)^(1/2+eps)). These concern the defined counters only and make no claim about SAT complexity or ETH. 54 theorems, no sorry, no native_decide, standard axioms only. The attached paper states exactly these results.
